notes: APACHE II definition: biopsy-proven cirrhosis and documented portal hypertension; past upper GI bleeding attributed to portal hypertension; or prior hepatic failure, encephalopathy or coma. Coded as a cirrhosis/chronic hepatic failure code plus evidence of portal hypertension or decompensation (portal hypertension, varices, hepatic failure or encephalopathy, ascites, hepatorenal syndrome). Biopsy can't be checked from codes.

APACHE II definition: New York Heart Association class IV. ICD codes don't record NYHA class. End-stage heart failure and an assist device are the closest markers; 'any heart failure' is optional because it over-counts.

APACHE II definition: chronic restrictive, obstructive or vascular disease causing severe exercise restriction; or documented chronic hypoxia, hypercapnia, secondary polycythemia, severe pulmonary hypertension (>40 mmHg) or respirator dependency. Pulmonary hypertension severity isn't coded. Chronic lung disease codes are optional because codes don't show severe exercise restriction.
APACHE II definition: receiving chronic dialysis.

APACHE II definition: therapy that suppresses resistance to infection (immunosuppression, chemotherapy, radiation, long-term or recent high-dose steroids) or a disease advanced enough to suppress it (leukemia, lymphoma, AIDS). Solid-organ transplant status is included as a marker of ongoing immunosuppression. Inhaled steroids (Z79.51) are left out.
